m: At a *small altar*, you kneel on your *legs* and open your *mouth* to **wish** your friend luck.
Down the *hillside*, the postman drops a parcel into a *pit* by the road: the **mail** has come.
A *mouth* full of *soil*: quick, **spit** it out!
A *prowling dog* bares its teeth with a cold *glare*: **ruthless**.
Polish a sheet of *gold* until you can see your face: an old bronze **mirror**.
A *mouth* with a *plank* of tongue sticking out: it opens to **say** something.
Cut a *tree* branch, fix a *halberd* blade to it, clear the *grass*: a handy **tool**.
A *mouth* lifts the *lid*, parts the *curtains* and snaps like *scissors*: a **bite**.
A *teepee* on the *hillside* so close you can poke it with your *elbow*: your **neighbour**.
Stand in the hot *soil* all day and you get *red cheeks*: bright **red**.
A *helping hand* tries to **squeeze** through a *trimmed hedge*.
Put a *lid* on top of a *bow* and it stays **bent**.
Cut a *tree*, have a *big man* hammer a *nail*, and a *mouth* says "sit": a new **chair**.
Walk down the *hillside* to the *podium* with your friend and keep your *mouth* cheering: you **accompany** him.
Under the *roof*, a *standing knife* comes down to **cut** the meat.
A *helping hand* pulls the hood off a *cloaked beggar* in the *sun* to **uncover** who he is.
A *leather strap* wound around a *pole*: soft **leather**.
A *standing heart* winds a *spool* of thought until the *mouth* says "Aha!": you **realise**.
An *ear* that listens, *horns* that sense, a *mouth* that speaks well and a warm *heart*: so **clever**.
*Rain* hangs in the air, *trudging feet* and a *strong arm* push through the thick **fog**.
*Trudging feet* carry *gold coins* to buy a scythe for the *wheat*: it has a **sharp edge**.
A *tree* trunk with rungs like *horns* and a *slingshot* to reach the top: a **ladder**.
A *prowling dog* chases a small furry thing through the *grass* of a *rice field*: a **cat**.
A *sheep* walks up to the *small altar*: a **lucky** sign.
Open the *gate* and *water drops* stretch out like a long *tongue*: the river is **wide**.
Behind the *curtains*, every *speech bubble* is full of **praise**.
Sell *bamboo* and *wheat* with a *thumb*s up: we **raise funds** for the school.
A *person* and another *person* stand on one *plank*: a little **cluster**.
A *big man* takes the rope in his hand to **lead** his ox down the lane.
A *bird* opens its *mouth* to **chirp**.
*Water drops* soak a *pillow* until it begins to **sink**.
Through the *gate*, *trudging feet* climb to a *mouth*-shaped window of the **pavilion**.
A *grain stalk* laid on the grave, a *white dove*, *crumbs* of bread and *bristles* of a brush: a **solemn** offering.
A *lying man* has to **bend** to fit between one *mountain* and another *mountain*.
Unroll the *edict scroll* under the *sun* and tap it with a *spoon*: the king's **decree**.
A *shirt* has a *pit*-shaped opening where your arm goes in: the **sleeve**.
A *prowling dog* leaps a *hurdle* in the *sun*: off on the **hunt**.
A *lying man* with a *chili* in his *mouth* stretches out under the *moon* on his **arm**.
A *bug* crawls under the *roof* and a *spoon*-shaped head darts at it: a **snake**.
A *strong arm* hands over a *shell*, a *mouth* cheers: we **congratulate** you!
A *tree* trunk with a *candle* on top holds up the hall: a **pillar**.
A *helping hand* swings a *crowbar* with a *strong arm* and lets it **throw** far.
A little creature sneaks into the *mortar* to nibble rice: a **mouse**.
A *king* and another *king* listen to a *pinned heart* of music: the **zither**.
Join a *scythe* blade to a *plank*, add a *slide* and a *drop* of oil: the long war blade, a **halberd**.
A *cow* locked under a *roof*: a **prison** for the cow.
On the *road*, a *child* picks up *crumbs* and shares them, never boasting: **modest**.
A *swarm* of bees chases you down the *road* and you **stride** away fast.
A big kid steals your *candy* and gives a bored *yawn*: a **bully**.
A *mouth* gasps as a *cross* and a *root hook* lift a giant weight: one **ton**.
A *king* and another *king* sit by a *clock*, plucking strings in turn on the **zither**.
An old *robe* grows thin and frayed year by year: a slow **decline**.
A *door bar* with *horns* on top stands on a *tile*: a tall glass **bottle**.
A *standing heart* is poked again and again by a noisy neighbour and gets **annoyed**.
A small bird with a forked tail swoops low over the *embers*: a **swallow**.
A *standing person* aims right at the *bullseye*: the very **middle**.
A *small speech bubble* whispers sweet words, a *grain stalk* tied with a *ribbon* dangles: a **lure** for the birds.
A *prowling dog* sniffs out a *good meal* from miles away: a hungry **wolf**.
*Water drops* fill a hollow where a *scorpion* waits on the bank: a little **pond**.
On a *sickbed*, *trudging feet* throw off *two sparks* of pain: every step starts to **hurt**.
A *lying man* reads a *little fortune stick*: it tells him he is Mr **Lu**.
A *standing person* fights with a *cross* and *scissors*: a **battle**.
Lift the *cloth cover*: on *two planks* over a pair of *legs*, a *thumb* points to the gold **crown**.
A single grain of *rice* on a *podium*: one tiny **grain**.
A *claw* points down the long road to a land far, far **distant**.
One *mouth* above another *mouth*, singing in tune: the family **Lü**.
A *dark thread* hangs from a *cocoon* under a *lid*: **mysterious**.
*Crumbs* of *soil* float in the air: **dust**.
A *horse* slips on *icicles*: rider Mr **Feng** falls off.
A *helping hand* pats a *vanishing man* on the shoulder to **comfort** him.
*Water drops* so low that *twin blades* of grass poke out: the stream is **shallow**.
A *child* leans on his grandad's *cane* and never tells a lie: **honest**.
Untangle a *silk thread* from a *twisted vine* to **correct** the knot.
*Gold coins* pay for a *little fortune stick* that spins and bores a hole like a *mouth*: a **drill**.
One *sun*, then another, then a third shine back from a single gem: a bright **crystal**.
Tie a *coiled rope* round a *mountain* and pull? **How could** you move it?
A *person* lays *two planks* across a crack in the *mountain* while a goat with *horns* watches: a deep **gorge**.
A *person* and a *bowing man* lie in the tall *grass*: the field is **dark green**.
A *mouth* full of water aims at the *cross* and lets out a **spray**.
A *plough* drags through *fur* and wears it all away: it will **consume** everything.
*Trudging feet* climb past the *icicles* until they seem to **soar** above the clouds.
Take a *tall cane* to the *tower* door and **knock**.
Inside a *fence*, by a damp *grain stalk* in the *grass*, something grows: a **fungus**.
Climb the *podium*, open your *mouth* to say sorry, and hand over a *shell* to **compensate**.
A *person* dips a finger in *water drops* of paint to **smear** the wall.
Lift the *lid* on a bag of *rice*: every grain is white and **pure**.
A *nameboard* hangs on a *door* under an *archway* above the *grass*: thin and **flat**.
*Two planks* patch a *leaky pot* with a *snake bend* crack: the shop starts to **lose money**.
Under the *roof*, *upstairs*, a *right hand* brushes away *crumbs*: the house is **silent**.
Black lumps burn in the *campfire* sweet as *candy*, made from an ancient *tree*: **coal**.
An *elbow* swipes under the *moon* beside glowing *embers*: a **bear** at the camp.
Jump the *hurdle*, part the *curtains*, set down a *heart cushion* for your guest: **respectful**.
*Water drops* fall from the *scaffold* faster than the *sun* can dry them: everything is **wet**.
*Footsteps* past a *leaning cliff* to a *cross*: keep an *eye* on the trail and **follow** it.
The *sun* and a *claw* wrapping you in a blanket: **warm**.
Sacks of *rice* and something sweeter stored in a *shed*: **sugar**.
At the *stop sign*, a guard takes a *shell* from every traveller: a road **tax**.
A *helping hand* holds down a *kneeling man* to **restrain** him.
Line up every *grain stalk*, hunt down each *lost arrow*: put things in **order**.
A *towel* folded under an *archway* of *two planks* just above the *eye*: a **hat**.
A *mouth* wails inside a dark *robe*: deep **grief**.
Under a *roof*, a *standing person* pays a *banknote* to **stay overnight**.
A *kicking foot* splashes through *water* in the *sun*: **tread** the puddles.
A *campfire* boils a goat with *horns* on *three planks* for hours: the meat is **mushy**.
A long robe trailing on the *soil*: the robe of Mr **Yuan**.
A *standing person* with a bow and target, ruling a fief: the **marquis**.
A *helping hand* holds a *dipper* that starts to **shake**.
A *person* squeezes a goat's *horns* between *two planks*: a big **clip**.
*Twins* play in the *sun*: the taller one is the **elder brother**.
Under the *moon*, meat hangs on a *drying rack*: a slice of **liver**.
A *helping hand* under the *roof* polishes the *altar*: **wipe** it clean.
A *prowling dog* with *grey hair* naps in the *sun* next to a muddy **pig**.
Heat ore over a *campfire* to **refine** it.
A *standing heart* watches the *horizon*: always there, **constant**.
A *standing heart* looks with a sharp *eye* at a *cross*-roads: be **careful**.
A *helping hand* loads a *boat* with a *war club* and all your things: time to **move**.
A *silk thread*, a *knife* and *two planks* of wood: sew on a **button**.
A *silk thread* stitched like a *tattoo*: a fine **pattern**.
A *king* holds up a *hide* so thin you can see through it, like **glass**.
*Water drops* fly as a *fish* leaps from the net: **fishing**.
A *stone* pulls *antlers*, a *cocoon* and another *cocoon* to it: it is **magnetic**.
*Gold coins* under an *archway* beside a *covered mouth*: not gold but **copper**.
Behind the *stop sign* of your lips sit your *teeth*: each one a **tooth**.
A *kicking foot*, a *big man*, and a *leaky pot* in the way: **stride across** it.
A *helping hand* passes a watch under an *archway* to the shop: you **pawn** it.
A *standing heart* sees a *left hand* pull a *towel* off a ghost's face: pure **terror**.
No *water drops*, no *grass*, only *sun* beating on a *big man*: a **desert**.
Lying on a *sickbed* wrapped in a *hide*: too **weary** to move.
A beast with *horns* climbs a *leaning cliff* and shakes a *right hand* at the king: a **rebel**.
On the *road*, a *tied sack* from the *stacked drawers* is handed to a messenger: **dispatch** it now.
Point at *antlers* over a *cocoon* and another *cocoon*: "**this** one, right here."
Lay meat on the *altar* to **offer sacrifice** to the ancestors.
Lift the *lid* off the *wine jug* one time too many: **drunk**.
A goat with *horns* behind the *curtains* sees a *hand* curl up into a **fist**.
A *bow*, a *bent knife* and *crumbs* scatter until they **fill** the whole room.
A *person* tips a *dipper* sideways: it hangs **slanting**.
A *tree* cut into shelves, *sprinkles* of dust, a *comb* to sort the papers: the **files**.
A *grain stalk*, *scissors*, a *left hand* and a *towel* left in an empty field: things are **rare** here.
A *helping hand* grabs the enemy by the *ankle*: **victory**!
Under the *moon*, a *person* lies on *two planks* to tan their **skin**.
Every *sickbed* is full and guards with a *war club* close the town: an **epidemic**.
Under the *moon*, a wasp stings you right in the *bullseye* and it starts to **swell**.
A *covered mouth* with little *antlers* sprouting on top: a **bean**.
*Sprinkles* of skin fly in the *moon*light as a *standing knife* starts to **peel** an apple.
On a *mountain*, under an *archway* crossed like *scissors*: the guard's **post**.
*Sun* hits *sprinkles* of glitter on a *tall stool* and they **dazzle** your eyes.
Open your *mouth* as wide as the *sky* and **swallow** it whole.
Under a *roof*, a *left hand* and an *elbow* stretch out wide: the hall is **grand**.
On a *sickbed*, a *mouth*, another *mouth* and a third *mouth* whisper about a lump as big as a *mountain*: **cancer**.
Under the *moon*, a man pats his round **belly** full of *soil*-baked potatoes.
